business_problem: Today, its digital subsidiary, KURZ DIGITAL, uses Google Cloud to pioneer revolutionary battery tracking and lifecycle management, turning regulatory compliance into strategic business value.
solution_summary: Today, its digital subsidiary, KURZ DIGITAL, uses Google Cloud to pioneer revolutionary battery tracking and lifecycle management, turning regulatory compliance into strategic business value. Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE) Autopilot: A fully managed container orchestration platform that enables seamless deployment and operation of the Battery Passport application without the complexity of infrastructure management. Cloud SQL : A reliable, high-performance relational database for securely storing and quickly retrieving battery data, compliance records, and recycling information. Key components include BigQuery stores and queries the analytics and AI-ready datasets that power the workload; Vertex AI provides the reasoning or generation layer used for classification, orchestration, content generation, or analysis; Cloud SQL stores transactional state and application data for the operational workflow at low latency; Cloud Storage stores large files, lake data, or static assets that.
